result.result:
The Kanban board is built and all 11 requirements work at 1280px and 375px. Both test suites pass: 28 unit tests for the logic, and 18 browser tests in real Chrome. Typecheck and lint are clean. Nothing is committed yet.

**How it works**
- **Dragging:** I wrote it myself rather than adding a library, so the same code handles mouse, touch and pen. With a mouse you can drag a card from anywhere on it. On touch you drag from the dotted handle on the left edge, so touching the rest of the card still scrolls the page. The page scrolls on its own when you drag near the top or bottom edge, and Escape cancels a drag.
- **Keyboard:** each card has a "Move to…" dropdown. If you Tab to a card, Shift+←/→ moves it to the next column, Shift+↑/↓ moves it up or down in its column, and focus stays on the card. A screen reader announces the card's new position.
- **Work-in-progress limit:** Doing shows "n / 3". When it has more than 3 cards, the column turns amber and shows a warning. You can still add the fourth card; it only warns.
- **Search and filter:** while a search or priority filter is on, column counts show "shown/total". Dragging cards still drops them in the right place while the board is filtered.
- **Saving:** the board is saved to localStorage in a versioned format. If the saved data is damaged, the app drops the bad entries instead of crashing. Changes made in another tab show up in this one.

**Bugs found and fixed while clicking through**
- At 375px the "High" priority button stuck out past the edge of the add/edit dialog. The dialog fields now stack on phones, and a browser test checks for this overflow.
- On overdue cards, the thick red left border pushed the text out of line with other cards. It's now a stripe that doesn't move the text.
- Edit and Delete buttons were too small to tap on mobile, so I made them bigger.

**What I tested and how**
- **Unit tests (Vitest, `npm test`), 28 tests:** adding, editing and deleting cards, including trimming text and rejecting bad input. Moving cards within a column, between columns, into an empty column and while filtered. The keyboard moves and what happens at the first and last column. Overdue rules, including a card due today, one with no date, and one in Done. The limit (3 cards is fine, 4 warns). Search matching without regard to capitals, and the priority filter. Saving and loading, including damaged data, duplicate cards and storage that refuses to save.
- **Browser tests (Playwright in installed Chrome, `npx playwright test`):** each one runs at 1280×800 and again at 375×740 with touch turned on:
  - three columns with counts and empty-column messages, and no sideways scrolling
  - adding a card (empty title is rejected), adding straight into a column, editing, Escape closing without saving, and delete with Cancel and then Delete
  - keyboard moves, including focus staying on the card, the screen-reader message, and the "Move to" dropdown
  - the warning appearing at 4 cards in Doing and clearing when one leaves
  - search by title and by description, the priority filter, the "no results" message and Clear filters
  - overdue highlighting, and the highlight going away when the card moves to Done
  - the board surviving a reload
- **Drag tests:**
  - Mouse, at desktop size: reordering, moving between columns, dropping into an empty column, Escape cancelling, then a reload to check the result was saved.
  - Touch, at mobile size: real touch events sent through Chrome's DevTools protocol (CDP). Reordering and moving between columns, touching the card body scrolls instead of dragging, and the page auto-scrolls when dragging to Done below the screen.
  - Two browser tests are skipped on purpose because each drag test runs at only one size: mouse at desktop, touch at mobile.
- **Looking at it myself:** I saved screenshots from each test at both sizes and looked at them: empty board, full board, dialogs, the delete confirmation, the limit warning, no results, overdue cards and a drag in progress. That's how I found the three bugs above.

The "Doing" column is now called "In progress" everywhere it appears: the column heading, the move dropdowns, the over-limit warning and the screen-reader messages. Card titles in Done are struck through and greyed. All tests pass.

- **Rename:** only the label changed. The column's internal name in saved data is still "doing", so boards already saved in the browser still load.
- **Strikethrough:** it follows the card. A card moved into Done gets it, and a card moved out loses it.
- **One extra fix:** the rename made each card's move dropdown read "In: In progress", so the current column's option now shows just its name, e.g. "In progress".

**What I checked**
- **Existing tests:** all 28 unit tests pass. The browser tests run in Chrome at 1280×800 and 375×740 with touch on: 20 pass, and 2 are skipped on purpose because the mouse-drag test runs only at desktop size and the touch-drag test only at mobile size.
- **Updated tests:** the column-heading test now expects "In progress" and checks that no "Doing" heading is left. The limit test checks the full warning: "4 cards in In progress (limit 3)". The limit test also starts from a board saved with the old internal name, which confirms old data still appears in the renamed column.
- **New strikethrough test (both sizes):** it reads the style Chrome actually applies to each title. Done titles are struck through and To do / In progress titles are not. Moving a card into Done adds the line, and moving one out removes it.
- **Screenshots:** I looked at the board at 1280px and 375px. "In progress" fits in the column header and the warning box on mobile, and the struck-through Done titles are readable at both sizes.

You can now have multiple boards. A bar under the header lets you switch, create, rename and delete boards, and each board has its own three columns and cards. Your existing board and its saved cards become the first board, "My board", with nothing lost. All tests pass (53 unit, 32 browser), and the production build and lint are clean. Nothing is committed yet.

- **Board switcher:** a dropdown showing each board with its card count, plus "+ New board", "Rename" and "Delete board".
  - **Create and rename:** both open a name dialog. New boards are pre-filled with "Board N" and become the active board. Empty names and names that already exist (ignoring capitals) are rejected with a message.
  - **Delete:** asks for confirmation, naming the board and how many cards it holds. The button is disabled when only one board is left, and the delete logic refuses as well.
  - **Remembered:** the boards and which one is active survive a reload.
- **Card menu:** each card now has a "⋯" menu with "Move to board…" and "Delete…". The card's Delete button moved into this menu, and Edit stays as its own button. The menu works with the keyboard (arrow keys, Home/End, Escape) and closes when you click elsewhere.
- **Move to board:** opens a list of your other boards. The card keeps its column and goes to the end of it, and you stay on the current board. If you only have one board, the dialog offers "Create a board" and moves the card into the new one.
- **Existing data:**
  - **New format:** boards are saved under a new key (`kanban-workspace-v2`). On first load the old single board (`kanban-board-v1`) is copied into "My board" with all cards, columns, order and fields intact.
  - **Old copy kept:** the old saved data is never changed or deleted. If the new data were ever corrupted, the app would load from the old copy instead, so cards can't be lost.
  - **Damaged entries:** data that is partly broken is repaired rather than dropped. A card whose ID duplicates one on another board gets a new ID instead of being discarded.

**What I tested and how**
- **Unit tests (Vitest, `npm test`):** 25 new tests for the board logic, 53 in total. They cover:
  - creating and switching boards, and name checks (empty, too long, duplicate, re-casing a board's own name)
  - rename, and delete (which board becomes active, never deleting the last one)
  - moving cards between boards (column kept, added at the end, unknown boards or cards ignored)
  - the old-to-new migration: every card and field kept, the old data left untouched, new data preferred once it exists, and falling back to the old data if the new data is corrupt
  - repairing damaged data, and storage that refuses to read or save
- **Browser tests (Playwright in Chrome at 1280×800 and 375×740 with touch, `npx playwright test`):** 6 new tests, each run at both sizes:
  - Migration: old-format data shows up as "My board (4)" with columns, order, priority, description and the overdue highlight intact. I checked what's saved in localStorage, then that changes made after migration survive a reload.
  - Create, switch, rename and delete boards, including name checks, Escape cancelling, the confirmation (Cancel, then Delete), the button disabled on the last board, and a reload.
  - "Move to board…" with the mouse, and the card menu with the keyboard only.
  - Creating a board from the move dialog when you only have one board.
  - Nothing runs off the screen, even with a very long board name.
- **Existing browser tests:** they still pass. Most of them now load their starting data in the old format, so they exercise the migration too.
  - Test changes: the card-delete steps now go through the menu. The touch-drag test now scrolls the column into view first, because the taller mobile header put the target card at the screen edge, where the page auto-scrolls during a drag (which is intended).
- **Looking at it myself:** I checked screenshots at both sizes of the board bar, card menu, move dialog, new-board and delete-board dialogs, and the migrated board. I found nothing broken.
